data.title: Xin Baoxiao Xiaoyuan
data.title_japanese: 新爆笑校园 第一季
data.synopsis:
It tells the story of the protagonist, Daitou, who comes to the city from a village called Baichi Village to study and work. He meets various classmates and friends such as Wangcai, Xiaoyin, Nuomi Tuan, and Gao Chaisheng, and they share their hilarious daily life of studying and living together.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

data.title: Shen Qian: Qiangzhi Daodai
data.synopsis:
In a fictional sci-fi world, alien beings known as "Hundred-Beak" intend to control the consciousness of all humanity. A young girl named Li Haila unites with a human force to resist the alien invasion, learns the mystery of her own origins, and ultimately thwarts the alien life form's plan, protecting the fate of humanity.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

data.title: Yuan Jing Zhi Dian
data.synopsis:
Yi Wu was thrust onto the World Cup stage because of a single online "like." He then inexplicably appeared in a closed arena, where a countdown was implanted in everyone. To gain time to survive, they had to engage in a new, multi-strategy competition, escape perilous environments, and navigate secret chambers. This unique environment forced them to both cooperate and compete, and behind it all, a legend of a "spiritual kingdom" seemed to be circulating.

(Source: iQIYI, translated)
